name: cpersona
description: Hooks and an agent skill that make an agent use CPersona's memory at the right moments: look before the first action and before each answer, store as it goes, and restore the task after the conversation is compacted. Connect the CPersona MCP server separately.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: The agent_id this agent stores and recalls its memory under. Use the same one wherever the agent should share that memory. Left empty, the agent uses "default", or the agent_id your CLAUDE.md already names.
